sloka: एवं ते राक्षसा तेन हरिणा कमलेक्षण ।बहुशः संयुगे भग्ना हतप्रवरनायकाः ।। ७.८.२१ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ te rākṣasā tena hariṇā kamalekṣaṇa ।bahuśaḥ saṁyuge bhagnā hatapravaranāyakāḥ ।। 7.8.21 ॥

translations.english: O lotus-eyed one, those Rākṣasas were repeatedly defeated in battle by that Hari (Vishnu), having their chief leaders slain.
